name: fault_status_array
comment: per-fault record flags byte (170x3B records; array base)

name: fault_pending_flags_b
comment: 32-bit fault-pending bitmap init 0xffffffff lockstep with fault_pending_flags

name: fault_status_word_array
comment: per-fault record packed word at record+1 (age/epoch/flags; array base)

name: diagnostic_status_flags_working
comment: fault status bits incl 0x400 sensor mismatch

name: fault_aging_generation_counter
comment: wraps 0..0x50 generation stamp for fault aging

name: fault_ring_epoch_counts
comment: coolant-overtemp epoch byte + fault-queue count byte

name: protection_event_count_history
comment: 8-element occurrence counts parallel to SPN history (array base)

name: cold_start_protection_timer_countdown
comment: countdown gating cold-start protection state transitions

name: timing_limit_arbitrated_target
comment: arbitrated timing-limit target feeding the slew accumulator

name: cold_start_protection_cycle_counter
comment: 2-call debounce before advancing cold-start inner state

name: cold_start_protection_state
comment: cold-start battery voltage fault state machine (cases 0-8)

name: timing_limit_boost_blend_interp_state
comment: dualAxisTableInterpolation state for boost-map timing blend

name: protection_timer_dispatch_config
comment: NEVER-WRITTEN ROM cal; bits gate timerBitCheck sub-paths

name: j1939_protection_receive_delay_counter
comment: debounce for j1939 protection-receive; caps then sets status 0x8000

name: governor_load_cycle_delay_counter
comment: debounce for governor load cycle; caps then sets protection_monitor_shadow 8

name: sensor_channel_type_table
comment: NEVER-WRITTEN ROM table; channel->override/QADC type (array base)

name: engine_sync_type_code
comment: NEVER-WRITTEN config; ==0x13ec selects ISB sync paths

name: diag_suppress_request_flag
comment: set=1 by protection FSMs to request diag suppression

name: injection_fault_shadow_snapshot
comment: snapshot of injection_fault_shadow_flags for change detect

name: j1939_dm1_crank_counter_prev
comment: previous-cycle cold_start_crank_counter for DM1 crank detect

name: j1939_dm1_cycle_tick
comment: running tick for DM1 message scheduling (mod-10)

name: sensor_channel_enable_flags
comment: NEVER-WRITTEN ROM; per-group channel enable bits (array base)

name: cbd_warmup_cycle_threshold
comment: NEVER-WRITTEN ROM; CBD warmup cycle threshold (x100)

name: fuel_demand_protection_init_flag
comment: first-entry sentinel arming the hysteresis counter

name: j1939_fuel_demand_overflow_flags
comment: overflow bits for the 4 fuel-demand accumulators

name: j1939_fuel_demand_tick_at_target_rpm
comment: fuel-demand ticks while at target RPM

name: cbd_governor_integrator_snapshot
comment: governor integrator snapshot for CBD settle check

name: cbd_channel_enabled_flag
comment: set when any CBD-monitored status bit active

name: cbd_cylinder_event_wait_counter
comment: cycles waiting for a cylinder event index

name: cbd_cylinder_advance_pending_flag
comment: set when cylinder event index advanced past target

name: cbd_active_cylinder_count
comment: count of active cylinders; >=2 sets fault bit

name: cruise_speed_upper_limit_ptr
comment: ptr to cruise speed upper limit (cal or working) (ROM-aliased)

name: throttle_setpoint_limit_arg
comment: computed ptr arg to cm848_throttleSetpoint_limit (was PTR_DAT)

name: throttle_integral_period_counter
comment: countdown period for throttle integral accumulation

name: cruise_fuel_demand_mode_prev
comment: prev governor_fuel_demand_mode for cruise PID path (ROM-aliased)

name: cruise_speed_rate_term
comment: cruise speed rate-of-change term into PID integrator (ROM-aliased)

name: iat_solenoid_duty_countdown
comment: remaining ticks in solenoid duty pulse

name: iat_protection_level6_grace_count
comment: grace countdown at derate level 6 before shutdown

name: iat_protection_total_derate_steps
comment: total permitted IAT derate steps from table
